message: Registered treasury chest, all placed states and production public/governor menus render with valid models and textures; native currency controls and their request payloads passed.
interfaceData: Demonstration data in the actual production TreasuryScreen
currencyInteractionChecks: Donation defaults to the active available currency, switches both ways, clears amounts, parses Chronicle cents, rejects fractional emeralds, and preserves both credit claims.
Policy currency clears fixed tax and salary, preserves independent market tax at 500 basis points and historical credits, and saves Chronicle amounts as cents.
The governor edits market tax independently of the periodic/contract mode, saves exact basis points, rejects rates above 100%, and retains visible controls at 320x240.
Casino profit taxation retains its independent rate across currencies, parses 12.34% as 1234 basis points and rejects negative and above-100% values.
Without Chronicles, donations fall back to emeralds, Chronicle selection and claims are disabled, emerald claims remain available, and a saved Chronicle policy can recover to emeralds.
Public contract reward parsing and the published currency use the contract currency independently of the active policy currency.
requestTransport: Recorded locally; no game-server network requests
policyScreenshotPage: economy: independent market sales tax at 5%, casino profit tax at 7.25%, contract mode and salaries
